items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: He started out with Earl Hines, you know.

ctx.x: since -- as far as they ever were, they were at Armstrong. Now, there were -- over the radio at Sherman I used to hear bands like Les Hite and then there was a band called the Irving Brothers. And they were coming to the network from Culver City. Les Hite was there, Frank Sebastian's Cotton Club. And a . . .
What about the Earl Hines' Orchestra?
The Earl Hines? They were in Chicago. I didn't hear too much of Earl Hines -- at that time.
